newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LIIVIKO 44 PCT STAKE TO BE SOLD THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: LIIVIKO 44 PCT STAKE TO BE SOLD THIS YEAR.

text.p: The privatisation agency said on Thursday that it is to sell 44 percent of state alcohol producer and retailer Liiviko before the end of the year in the first stage of a three stage privatisation.
The selloff process will lead to 95 percent of the company being in private hands.

"The first tranche will be sold before the end of the year with 44 percent of the company sold to the public for privatisation vouchers," Kulliki Linnamagi, head of the agency's international relations department, told Reuters.
"A further 30 percent will be sold by tender to a strategic investor at a price based on the sale price determined by the voucher sale," she added.
The final tranche of 21 percent will be sold publicly for vouchers after a strategic investor has been found.
"The board of the agency decided on Wednesday to enter the company on the privatiation list and 95 percent of the company is up for sale, Linnamagi added.
Liiviko is the largest alcohol producer in Estonia.
